nom: The Crème Shop Miffy Clear As Day Blemish Patches

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the patches stayed on all night with no lifting and found the process of seeing the gunk absorbed satisfying.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer who dislikes the feeling of things on her face reports not feeling the patch at all and no irritation over an overnight wear.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples flattened, reduced in redness, or gone by morning after overnight wear, and several credit the patches with drawing out fluid or pus; a notable minority (index 0,2,3,6,12,24) report no visible change to their spots.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers describe visibly smaller, less inflamed blemishes the morning after use, including on chest and neck placements, though a few (index 4,8,17,25) say other brands worked better on their breakouts.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers specifically note reduced redness or swelling around the treated area overnight (index 7,19,20,31,35,46,67), with no dissent reported on this specific point.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin felt the patch containing tea tree and witch hazel left skin feeling less oily and calmer overall.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports no irritation and no residue or film left on the skin after removal, and another confirms no drying effect on surrounding skin.

aspects.libelle: Patches too large for small spots
Painful or hard to peel off

extraits.texte: I was very skeptical about this product. It looked more like thick stickers that a pimple path. I used one on my nose last night, I have oily skin, and it stayed on all night. No lifting or moving. Great gripping power. It's very satisfying to see all that gunk in the pimple patch.

As someone who hates the feeling of things on my face I was concerned that the Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches would be uncomfortable for me to wear, however, I put them on after my evening shower to leave until the next day as the instructions adviced and I didn't feel them at all! They also have very good staying power, at one point I started showering forgetting I'd put a patch on and only realized after I bumped my finger against it while cleansing my face. I put them over some of my larger inflamed pimples and personally I felt like when I took them off they definitely made the pimples much less noticeable and helped with the redness. They didn't leave a film after taking them off either which is another plus. All in all I find that the Miffy Clear As Day! Blemish Patches definitely perform as advertised and are worth at least a try!

My Review of Miffy Clear as Day! Blemish Patch: I was honestly surprised by how well these little patches worked. I popped one on a stubborn pimple before bed, and by morning, the redness and swelling had noticeably gone down. They're super easy to use, stay put through the night, and don't irritate my skin at all. I love that they have Tea Tree and Witch Hazel which made my skin felt calmer, less oily, and just overall clearer. It's become my go-to anytime a breakout pops up.
Didnt absorb like patches with just hydrocolloid do and caused a red patch in the shape of Miffy that's lasting a few days now

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. First of all, these pimple patches are ADORABLE!!! I have two toddlers who are constantly trying to peel these "stickers" off my face! I have resorted to using them after bed time so that I can actually reap the benefits of the patches. When I received these, I just happened to have a painful pimple under my nose. In just two uses, my pimple was brought to a head, and in the third, it sucked the yucky stuff out and it no longer hurt! It was flat and on its way to disappearing. Some of the patches are a little bigger, which I can see how that would be beneficial for cystic acne. Overall, they work just as good as other brands and are super cute! 10/10 would recommend!

Absolutely love the designs of the patches! Would put on at night and in the morning there was a big difference both visually and physically where they were applied. It was a bit painful to remove, especially for the largest ones, but I never had an issue with them peeling while I wore them (and I'd rather have the product stick a bit too well than not enough). For people looking for patches, I would definitely recommend these!
It barley stayed on, I applied it to clean dry skin but it would keep slipping and falling. So it's a no for me though the designs are super cute.
